<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 400">
  <title>Pythagoras' Theorem</title>
  
  <style>
    <![CDATA[
      .bg { fill: #ffffff; }
      .title-text { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 20px; fill: #0f172a; }
      .subtitle-text { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #475569; }
      .label-text { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px; fill: #1e293b; }
      .hyp-text { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 15px; fill: #ea580c; }
      .formula-text { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 22px; fill: #0f172a; }
      .sq-a { fill: #93c5fd; stroke: #2563eb; stroke-width: 2; fill-opacity: 0.6; }
      .sq-b { fill: #86efac; stroke: #16a34a; stroke-width: 2; fill-opacity: 0.6; }
      .sq-c { fill: #fdba74; stroke: #ea580c; stroke-width: 2; fill-opacity: 0.6; }
      
      @keyframes pulse {
        0%, 100% { fill-opacity: 0.4; }
        50% { fill-opacity: 0.8; }
      }
      .animated-sq {
        animation: pulse 3s infinite ease-in-out;
      }
    ]]>
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="600" height="400" class="bg" />

  <!-- Title & Explanation -->
  <text x="30" y="40" class="title-text">Pythagoras' Theorem</text>
  <text x="30" y="62" class="subtitle-text">In a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to</text>
  <text x="30" y="80" class="subtitle-text">the sum of the squares of the other two sides.</text>

  <!-- Visual Representation of Squares (Fit inside 20px-380px boundary) -->
  <!-- Triangle Vertices: C(180, 260), A(180, 170), B(300, 260) -->
  <!-- Side a = BC = 120 (bottom), Side b = AC = 90 (vertical left), Side c = AB = 150 (hypotenuse) -->
  
  <!-- Square b^2 (left of AC): 90x90, top-left at (90, 170) -->
  <rect x="90" y="170" width="90" height="90" class="sq-b animated-sq" />
  <text x="135" y="220" text-anchor="middle" class="label-text" fill="#15803d">b²</text>

  <!-- Square a^2 (below BC): 120x120, top-left at (180, 260) -->
  <rect x="180" y="260" width="120" height="120" class="sq-a animated-sq" />
  <text x="240" y="325" text-anchor="middle" class="label-text" fill="#1d4ed8">a²</text>

  <!-- Square c^2 (along hypotenuse): Vector AB is (120, -90). Perpendicular pointing outward/up-right is (90, 120). -->
  <!-- Points: A(180,170) -> B(300,260) -> (390, 170) -> (270, 80) -->
  <polygon points="180,170 300,260 390,170 270,80" class="sq-c animated-sq" />
  <text x="285" y="175" text-anchor="middle" class="label-text" fill="#c2410c">c²</text>

  <!-- Main Triangle -->
  <polygon points="180,170 180,260 300,260" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />

  <!-- Right Angle Marker -->
  <path d="M 180,248 L 192,248 L 192,260" fill="none" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Labels for Sides -->
  <!-- Side a -->
  <text x="240" y="252" text-anchor="middle" class="label-text">a</text>
  <!-- Side b -->
  <text x="195" y="220" text-anchor="start" class="label-text">b</text>
  <!-- Side c -->
  <text x="230" y="205" text-anchor="end" class="label-text">c</text>

  <!-- Hypotenuse Pointer & Text -->
  <path d="M 235,212 L 150,120" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
  <circle cx="235" cy="212" r="3" fill="#ea580c" />
  <rect x="55" y="95" width="100" height="30" rx="4" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#ffedd5" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="105" y="115" text-anchor="middle" class="hyp-text">hypotenuse</text>

  <!-- Formula Display Card -->
  <rect x="360" y="280" width="210" height="90" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="465" y="320" text-anchor="middle" class="formula-text">a² + b² = c²</text>
  <text x="465" y="348" text-anchor="middle" class="subtitle-text" font-size="13">Pythagorean Equation</text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 400">
  <title>States of Matter</title>
  <style>
    .title { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .heading { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; text-anchor: middle; }
    .desc { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: #475569; text-anchor: middle; }
    .box { fill: #f8fafc; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 2; rx: 8px; }
    
    /* Solid Animation: Vibration */
    .s1 { animation: vib1 0.3s infinite alternate ease-in-out; }
    .s2 { animation: vib2 0.25s infinite alternate ease-in-out; }
    @keyframes vib1 { 0% { transform: translate(0, 0); } 100% { transform: translate(2px, -2px); } }
    @keyframes vib2 { 0% { transform: translate(0, 0); } 100% { transform: translate(-2px, 1px); } }

    /* Liquid Animation: Moving past each other */
    .l1 { animation: liq1 3s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .l2 { animation: liq2 3.5s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .l3 { animation: liq3 2.8s infinite ease-in-out; }
    @keyframes liq1 { 0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); } 50% { transform: translate(6px, -4px); } }
    @keyframes liq2 { 0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); } 50% { transform: translate(-6px, 3px); } }
    @keyframes liq3 { 0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); } 50% { transform: translate(4px, 5px); } }

    /* Gas Animation: Fast, random movement */
    .g1 { animation: gas1 2s infinite linear; }
    .g2 { animation: gas2 1.8s infinite linear; }
    .g3 { animation: gas3 2.2s infinite linear; }
    .g4 { animation: gas4 1.9s infinite linear; }
    .g5 { animation: gas5 2.1s infinite linear; }

    @keyframes gas1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(40px, -50px); }
      50% { transform: translate(80px, 10px); }
      75% { transform: translate(30px, 60px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gas2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(-60px, 70px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-20px, -40px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gas3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
